description: This file defines a composable UI screen for editing or creating tasks within a task management app. It includes a modal bottom sheet with input fields for task title and description, a toggle for completion status, and save actions. The code leverages Jetpack Compose Material3 components and demonstrates custom lightweight layout constructs to avoid inline issues.

methods.name: TaskEditorSheet
methods.description: Main composable for rendering a task editing/creating modal bottom sheet with input fields and controls.

methods.name: HeaderTitle
methods.description: Displays the header title 'Edit Task' or 'New Task' depending on editing mode.

methods.name: TitleField
methods.description: Input field for editing task title.

methods.name: DescriptionField
methods.description: Input field for editing task description.

methods.name: SaveButton
methods.description: Button to save the task, labeled accordingly based on editing mode.

methods.name: CompletedToggleLine
methods.description: Line containing a checkbox and label for marking task as completed.

methods.name: SimpleHorizontalLayout
methods.description: Custom lightweight composable layout to mimic a horizontal row without inline Row usage.
